author: WaveConquerer
body:
A nice addition to Nexus, and any game mode for that matter, would be that when a match ends it shows how many kills/points you obtained during a round.  Ex. In nexus I complete a match.  It then says to me "You have earned (x) kills this match!".  Or perhaps, in CTH i complete a match, and it says "You have earned (x) amount of points this match!".  Perhaps this could work for experience as well, who knows.

I know this would take work and may possibly tax the server's fps a bit (calculating everyone's scores may do that), but I think it'd be a welcome addition that would promote competition as well as give the players a way to rate themselves and see what tactics work best (maybe you get more kills as a Warrior than a Snake).

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
McZone had this feature, and you could also type /stats during the game to find out kills, deaths, K/D ratio for the game etc.

I would love to see this come back! It was quite cool to track your stats during games of Nexus, and I'm certain that many other players will appreciate it too.
